user.title: Connect to a SAJ inverter
user.description: Enter the local Modbus TCP endpoint, polling interval and model. Leave the model on Automatic unless the inverter is not recognised.

data_description.prefix: Optional. Adds a prefix to this installation's entity IDs, for example sensor.saj_house_pv_power instead of sensor.saj_pv_power. Use it when you have more than one SAJ system. Lowercase letters and digits only, no underscores, up to 32 characters, and no two installations can share one.

confirm_model.title: Confirm model
confirm_model.description: The device reports type {device_type}, which is not recognised as {model}, so it could not be verified as that model. Its required registers answered, but readings may be wrong if it is a different model. Use {model} anyway?

error.invalid_host: Enter a host name or IP address.
error.invalid_unit_id: Enter a whole-number unit ID from 1 to 247.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or read the inverter. Check the endpoint and try again.
error.unsupported_device: The device reports type {device_type}, which is not recognised automatically. Choose its model manually.
error.invalid_device_data: The inverter returned invalid identity or telemetry data.
error.timeout: The inverter did not respond in time. Check the endpoint and try again.
error.read_rejected: The inverter rejected a required register read. Check that this is a supported SAJ device and model.
error.invalid_port: Enter a whole-number port from 1 to 65535.
error.invalid_endpoint: Enter a valid port and unit ID.
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a whole-number polling interval of at least 10 seconds.
error.model_mismatch: This device identifies as {detected_model}, not {selected_model}. Choose {detected_model} or Automatic.
error.unknown_model: The model {selection} is not a known model. Choose Automatic or one of the listed models.
error.invalid_prefix: Use only lowercase letters and digits, with no underscores, up to 32 characters.
error.prefix_shadows_sensor: This prefix would make entity IDs that clash with a sensor name. Choose a different prefix.
error.prefix_in_use: Another SAJ Local installation already uses this prefix. Leaving it empty also counts, so only one installation can have no prefix.
error.entity_id_taken: The entity ID {entity_id} is already taken in Home Assistant. Choose a different prefix.

abort.confirmation_not_pending: No validated change is awaiting confirmation.

init.title: Connection and polling
init.description: Enter the local Modbus TCP endpoint, polling interval and model. Settings are saved after the endpoint is validated.

data_description.prefix: Optional. Adds a prefix to this installation's entity IDs, for example sensor.saj_house_pv_power instead of sensor.saj_pv_power. Use it when you have more than one SAJ system. Lowercase letters and digits only, no underscores, up to 32 characters, and no two installations can share one. Changing it renames this installation's entities after you confirm.

confirm_replacement.title: Confirm inverter replacement
confirm_replacement.description: Replace the hardware for this existing installation with the {model} with serial {serial}? Your sensor entities and their historical data remain with this installation.

confirm_model.title: Confirm model
confirm_model.description: The device reports type {device_type}, which is not recognised as {model}, so it could not be verified as that model. Its required registers answered, but readings may be wrong if it is a different model. Use {model} anyway?

confirm_prefix.title: Confirm entity ID change
confirm_prefix.description:
Entity IDs change from `{old_pattern}` to `{new_pattern}`.

History and long-term statistics move to the new entity IDs.

Automations, scripts, dashboards, templates and Energy settings that use the old entity IDs will stop working until you update them.

Entities you renamed yourself are left alone. Change the entity IDs?

user.title: Add polling group
user.description: Sensors in a polling group are read at the group's own interval. All other sensors are read at the default interval.

reconfigure.title: Edit polling group
reconfigure.description: Sensors in a polling group are read at the group's own interval. A sensor can belong to one group only.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter a whole-number polling interval of at least 10 seconds.
error.sensor_in_other_group: A selected sensor already belongs to another polling group.

abort.no_sensors: This installation has no sensors yet, so a polling group cannot be created.
abort.all_sensors_assigned: Every sensor already belongs to a polling group, so there is none left to add.

unsupported_device.message: The connected device reports type {device_type}, which is not recognised. Choose its model in Configure.

invalid_device_data.message: The inverter returned invalid identity or telemetry data.

cannot_connect.message: Communication with the inverter failed. Check the endpoint, unit ID and connection.

timeout.message: The inverter did not respond before the request timed out. Check its power, network and unit ID.

read_rejected.message: The inverter rejected a required register read. Check the selected device type and register access.

identity_mismatch.message: The endpoint now identifies a different inverter. Check the configured endpoint.

model_mismatch.message: The connected device identifies as {detected_model}, not {selected_model}. Choose {detected_model} or Automatic in Configure.

unknown_model.message: The saved model {selection} is not a known model. Choose Automatic or a listed model in Configure.

backing_off.message: The inverter endpoint is backing off after repeated failures, so no connection was attempted. Home Assistant will retry automatically.
